statements.t: “In our ongoing Phase 3 REGAL trial of GPS, we are focused on completing the final analysis following the announcement of 80th event, and we expect to announce topline primary endpoint results this month.
In parallel, enrollment and dosing continue in our Phase 2 trial of tambiciclib (SLS009) in newly diagnosed AML, with preliminary topline data expected in the fourth quarter.
As announced earlier this month, we look forward to presenting our Phase 2 data in relapsed/refractory AML at the upcoming ASH in December.

In October 2026, the Company announced the required pre-specified 80 th event occurred, triggering the customary database lock, blinded data review procedures before statistical analysis, unblinding, and disclosure of topline results, which the Company expects to report this month.
